    # Hyndman-Fan type 5, 1-based, x sorted ascending finite

def interp_pos(x, r):
    # find i (0-based lower) and frac such that r = x[i] + frac*(x[i+1]-x[i])
    n = len(x)
    for i in range(n-1):
        if x[i] <= r <= x[i+1] and x[i+1] > x[i]:
            return i, (r - x[i])/(x[i+1]-x[i])
    if r == x[0]: return 0, 0.0
    if r == x[-1]: return n-1, 1.0
    return None, None

def doy_to_md(d):
    # month/day for day-of-year d (d != 60) under the task's numbering
    leap = d >= 61
    days = [31,29,31,30,31,30,31,31,30,31,30,31] if leap else [31,28,31,30,31,30,31,31,30,31,30,31]
    for m, nd in enumerate(days):
        if d <= nd: return m+1, d
        d -= nd
    raise ValueError(d)

def md_to_doy(m, dd):
    if (m,dd) == (2,29): return 60
    days = [31,28,31,30,31,30,31,31,30,31,30,31]
    cum = 0
    for mm in range(1, m):
        cum += days[mm-1]
    doy = cum + dd
    if m > 2: doy += 1   # leap-year offset (Feb 29 gets its own number 60)
    return doy

def hazen90_cols(A):
    """A: (W, C) float64, may contain NaN. Return hazen(0.9) quantile per column, ignoring NaN."""
    n = np.isfinite(A).sum(axis=0)
    S = np.sort(A, axis=0)  # NaNs sort to end
    out = np.full(A.shape[1], np.nan)
    ok = n > 0
    v = 0.9*n[ok] - 0.5
    vm = np.clip(v, 0.0, n[ok]-1)
    j = np.floor(vm).astype(np.int64)
    jj = np.clip(j+1, 0, n[ok]-1)
    g = vm - j
    cols = np.arange(n[ok].size)
    out[ok] = S[j, cols] + g*(S[jj, cols] - S[j, cols])
    return out, n
